summary: Wrote homily.tex and its two homily components: a 1,448-word two-column speech for an adult parish assembly (11.1 to 12.1 minutes at 120 to 130 words a minute, estimated from the word count and not timed), built on the third reviewed reading as research/interpretations.md 4.5 recommends, with the power on earth to forgive of Mt 9:6 taken from the second; and a terminal note on sources and delivery with nine References. Also updated the shared generation record and the production audit, and changed one manifest comment. The 3-page proof builds cleanly and reproducibly, every homily-preflight check passes, and no upstream document was edited. Two upstream observations are in production-review.md: advisory RES-034 on the Aquinas locus, and the unregistered New Advent delivery of Chrysostom on 1 Corinthians.
